_comment: Per-subject curation for the Guecha Warrior (Muisca) unit-analysis video. ingame_outcome + showcase_override reflect the in-game (golden rig, gRPC) recordings.
_ingame_note: The V2 sim's whole unexpected_win category was WRONG: it says the Guecha (a heavy javelineer) BEATS cavalry/elephants, but in-game every cavalry closes and slaughters it — Centurion (Guecha 1u vs 11), Cataphract (1u vs 14/14 survive), Heavy Camel (1u vs 18/18) — the single-column sim overrates the Guecha's javelin DPS vs closing melee. War/Battle Elephant and the splash Ballista Elephant likewise grind it down. All 8 unexpected_wins + Ballista Elephant move to expected_loss (verified on 4 diverse cavalry/elephants; the pattern is uniform + decisive). The EXPECTED wins (vs archers/slow melee it kites or out-tanks) ARE reliable: Mameluke 16u, Teutonic Knight 13u, Mangudai 6u, Arbalester 11u — all wins.
_showcase_note: Guecha's story: it beats archers + slow melee it can kite/out-tank (Expected Wins), but folds to anything that closes. Expected Counters = heavy cavalry that runs it down (dramatic: Guecha reduced to 1 unit). Unexpected Counters = fast infantry (Karambit, Eagle) + anti-archer skirms that beat it despite ranged countering them. No Unexpected Wins section (the sim's were all wrong).
